Subject: Implementation notes: streaming strategy + secure function calls + example schema

Hi team — following up with initial technical recommendations for the PoC. Keeping it pragmatic so you can demo quickly and validate schema-based consumers.

Streaming
- Recommendation: use Redwood streaming (chunked server-sent events) for incremental tokens. This provides low-latency partial responses and predictable fallbacks.
- Typical pattern: send a short prompt with a streaming flag; client listens for chunks and re-assembles. Avoid very large system messages to keep first-token latency low.
- Example for your web client: open a single SSE connection per conversation and render partial candidates as they arrive.

Function / tool-calling
- Use signed webhook invocation through Redwood's tool-calling interface. We can scope tokens so only the appointment-scheduler endpoint is reachable.
- For HIPAA: recommend mutual TLS for the webhook and restrict outbound addresses to a VPC egress list; logging at request-id level only.

Structured outputs / JSON schema
- Redwood supports schema-guided generation and post-response validation. For PoC, here's a minimal example you can validate against on ingest (sample-output-schema.json attached):

-- sample JSON schema (inline for easy copy) --
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "appointment_suggestion",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "patient_id": { "type": "string" },
    "suggested_times": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "start": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" },
          "end": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" },
          "confidence": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1 }
        },
        "required": ["start","end"]
      }
    },
    "source": { "type": "string" }
  },
  "required": ["patient_id","suggested_times"]
}
-- end schema --

- Validation flow: Redwood can surface schema mismatches as a structured error; we recommend running schema validation server-side before enqueueing to your analytics pipeline.

Security notes
- We will not persist raw prompt contents in logs for HIPAA-sensitive flows; instead, redacted summaries can be stored.

Next steps for PoC
- I can deploy a sandbox endpoint and share credentials for the BrightHealthAI API team to test.
- Please confirm whether you want function calls to be synchronous (immediate HTTP call) or asynchronous (job queued + callback).
